Published by Global Banking & Finance Review 
 Posted on November 12, 2026
 1 min read
Add as preferred source on Google
Quick Summary
 Strategy's shares last traded 6.49% below their previous close at 114.41 USD in the United States information technology sector.
 MSTR 114.41 -6.49%
 last traded price, 12 Nov 2026 Previous close 122.35 Market cap $37.8bn 
The figures in this article were checked against this snapshot before publication.
 On 12 November 2026, Strategy's shares last traded at 114.41 USD, 6.49% below their previous close of 122.35 USD. The company's market value stood at $37.85bn in the information technology sector.
 Last traded price 114.41 USD 
 Previous close 122.35 USD 
 Change from the previous close -6.49% 
 Market value $37.85bn 
 Prices of Strategy (MSTR), listed in United States, in the currency the stock trades in. The last traded price is the last price the shares changed hands at in the session of 12 November 2026, as reported after the market closed. It is not the exchange's official closing price, and the two can differ. The change compares it with the official close of the previous session, 11 November 2026. Market value is converted to US dollars at the ECB reference rate. We report a stock the day it ends a session 2% or more away from its previous close, where at least 100,000 shares or US$5 million traded in the previous session. How we compile these reports .
